TL;DR - If you have Windows 7, 8.1, or Most Especially 10, and value even the smallest bit of your privacy. Download, install, and activate this program immediately.

Unless you've been living under a very cozy rock w/ a built in Jacuzzi and a King-Size Temperpedic Bed, you've probably heard about how much flak Windows 10 has been getting by now. The main points of controversy surrounding this OS primarily consist of the Heavily Intrusive Telemetry that the OS has which sends massive amounts of data about people's habits and activities performed on Windows 10 directly to Microsoft. This is a MASSIVE Violation of Personal Privacy. But the worst part about it is that lot of this Telemetry can't even be turned off by the default settings of the OS itself, and only a very small handful of it actually can. Windows 10 literally watches your every move that you do on that OS, and it seems like there's nothing you can really do to stop it; since even the default settings only turn off a very small handful of the entire OS's telemetry.

Well, shit! Isn't there something I can do to stop this?

Thankfully, there is a way to completely block ALL of Windows 10's telemetry dead in its tracks. And the problem is, a lot of people don't seem to know about this program whatsoever. But I'll spell it out for you guys as clearly as I can. The program name is called Spybot Anti-Beacon. You may recognize the name from a fairly popular Anti-Spyware program by the name of Spybot Search & Destroy. That's because this program is literally made by the same people who made that program. Proof of this can be found here, as it's officially listed as one of their programs under "Other Downloads". This program is specifically designed to block all telemetry of Windows 10 completely. It injects entries into your System Hosts file to block Several Dozen IP Addresses that Microsoft uses to collect Telemetry Data immediately with just one click. Ontop of this, it also blocks dozens of Registry Entries, System Processes, and many more from calling home to Microsoft.

That's pretty cool. But just how much does Anti-Beacon block out that I can't turn off myself?

Well lemme show you a bit. This is a picture of Spybot Anti-Beacon itself. That's what it looks like when you have No Telemetry blocked whatsoever. Out of all those meters that you see there, the max that you can manually block with Windows 10's OS settings is only 2 of them. 2 out of 10 Bars of Telemetry are all that you, the user, are capable of blocking manually without this program. Those 8 other bars are completely unable to be blocked by normal means without this program. And that's not even including the optional blockings in the next tab over; which include Telemetry from things like OneDrive, Microsoft Office, and many more ontop of that. If you click "Show Details", it shows you exactly what it's blocking to the letter. Registry Entries, Processes, etc.... in detail, which looks like this.

Isn't it true that Microsoft tried to port over some of Windows 10's Telemetry Spying Techniques on Windows 7 and 8.1? Can I use this program on those too?

SpyBot Anti-Beacon is, in-fact, fully compatible with Windows 7 and 8.1 as well, since Microsoft did try to port over some of those telemetries to those OS'es too. I myself am still on Windows 7 for now, but I do plan to get Windows 10 hopefully next month or so. And you can be damn well certain that Spybot Anti-Beacon is going to be the Absolute Very First Program I am putting on my Windows 10 Install the moment it finishes setting up my desktop.

If I complete cut off Telemetry entirely, will any programs be effected by this?

98% of the time, No they won't. The only things that may or may not get effected by telemetry getting turned off are in the Optional Section of Anti-Beacon, which are totally up to you if you wanna turn them off or on. Always remember that you can easily turn Telemetry on and off at the press of a button with this program. You're in full control of what you wanna let slip through or not. But from my experiences with it and my friends who use it on their Windows 10 PCs right now, they have never complained about anything being effected by it. But just in case, Anti-Beacon does specifically warn you about specific telemetries in the Optional Section that if you turn them on, certain things will get effected. See for yourself some of the options that I'm talking about that have a Parenthesis Warning next to them. There's one that warns about Bing, and another for OneDrive. And in the Telemetry Extensive Lists, it blocks 5 IPs that could interfere with Skype's functionality. Thankfully, this is fixable by going into your Hosts file and deleting the following 5 Host Entries:

  • 0.0.0.0 ui.skype.com
  • 0.0.0.0 pricelist.skype.com
  • 0.0.0.0 apps.skype.com
  • 0.0.0.0 m.hotmail.com
  • 0.0.0.0 s.gateway.messenger.live.com

Keep that in mind if after you block, your Skype suddenly starts acting strange. Just delete those 5 entries, and your Skype will be fine. Another important thing to note is that with Windows 10, if you have Anti-Beacon fully immunized, it will most likely block the upgrade from build 10240 to 10586. All you need to do to fix this is just turn off Immunization, install the update, and turn Immunization back on. Once you do that, you're good to go.
